stories.title: The Secret in the Old Library
stories.subtitle: Rahasia di Perpustakaan Tua
stories.markdown:
# The Secret in the Old Library

Rahasia di Perpustakaan Tua

English Story

One afternoon, Emma visited an old library near her house. The building was quiet and a little dusty.

While walking between the shelves, she noticed a strange book. It looked older than the others.

Emma carefully opened it. Suddenly, a small piece of paper fell out.

It was a note. It said, “The treasure is hidden where the light touches the floor at noon.”

Emma felt curious. She looked around and waited.

At exactly noon, sunlight came through the window and touched a corner of the room.

Emma walked to that spot and found a small wooden box under a table.

She opened it slowly. Inside, there were old coins and a letter.

The letter said, “Knowledge is the real treasure.”

Emma smiled. She understood the message and carefully put everything back.

Arti Bahasa Indonesia

Suatu sore, Emma mengunjungi perpustakaan tua dekat rumahnya. Bangunan itu sunyi dan sedikit berdebu.

Saat berjalan di antara rak buku, dia melihat sebuah buku yang aneh. Buku itu terlihat lebih tua dari yang lain.

Emma dengan hati-hati membukanya. Tiba-tiba, selembar kertas kecil jatuh.

Itu adalah sebuah catatan. Tertulis, “Harta karun tersembunyi di tempat cahaya menyentuh lantai saat siang hari.”

Emma merasa penasaran. Dia melihat sekeliling dan menunggu.

Tepat pada siang hari, sinar matahari masuk melalui jendela dan menyentuh sudut ruangan.

Emma berjalan ke tempat itu dan menemukan sebuah kotak kayu kecil di bawah meja.

Dia membukanya perlahan. Di dalamnya terdapat koin-koin lama dan sebuah surat.

Surat itu berbunyi, “Pengetahuan adalah harta yang sesungguhnya.”

Emma tersenyum. Dia mengerti pesan itu dan dengan hati-hati mengembalikan semuanya.

stories.title: A Surprise Birthday Gift
stories.subtitle: Hadiah Ulang Tahun yang Tak Terduga
stories.markdown:
# A Surprise Birthday Gift

Hadiah Ulang Tahun yang Tak Terduga

English Story

It was Sarah’s birthday, but she felt a little sad. Her parents were busy, and none of her friends had called yet.

She sat quietly in her room and looked at her phone. “Maybe they forgot,” she thought.

In the evening, her mother said, “Can you help me in the kitchen?”

Sarah walked slowly to the kitchen. Suddenly, the lights went off.

“What’s happening?” she said.

Then, the lights turned on again. “Surprise!” everyone shouted.

Her friends and family were there with a big cake and colorful decorations.

Sarah was shocked and happy at the same time. “I didn’t expect this!” she said.

Her best friend smiled and said, “We would never forget your special day.”

Sarah felt warm inside. It was the best birthday she ever had.

Arti Bahasa Indonesia

Hari itu adalah ulang tahun Sarah, tetapi dia merasa sedikit sedih. Orang tuanya sibuk, dan belum ada temannya yang menelepon.

Dia duduk diam di kamarnya dan melihat ponselnya. “Mungkin mereka lupa,” pikirnya.

Pada malam hari, ibunya berkata, “Bisakah kamu membantuku di dapur?”

Sarah berjalan perlahan ke dapur. Tiba-tiba, lampu mati.

“Apa yang terjadi?” katanya.

Lalu, lampu menyala kembali. “Kejutan!” semua orang berteriak.

Teman-teman dan keluarganya ada di sana dengan kue besar dan dekorasi berwarna-warni.

Sarah terkejut dan bahagia sekaligus. “Aku tidak menyangka ini!” katanya.

Sahabatnya tersenyum dan berkata, “Kami tidak akan pernah melupakan hari spesialmu.”

Sarah merasa hangat di dalam hatinya. Itu adalah ulang tahun terbaik yang pernah dia rasakan.

stories.title: The Brave Little Girl
stories.subtitle: Gadis Kecil yang Berani
stories.markdown:
# The Brave Little Girl

Gadis Kecil yang Pemberani

English Story

One evening, a little girl named Maya was walking home with her younger brother.

Suddenly, the lights in the street went out. The road became dark and quiet.

Her brother held her hand tightly. “I’m scared,” he said.

Maya felt afraid too, but she tried to stay calm.

“Don’t worry, I’m here,” she said.

They continued walking slowly. The wind was blowing, and strange sounds came from the trees.

Maya looked around carefully and kept moving forward.

After a few minutes, they finally saw their house.

Her brother smiled and said, “You are very brave.”

Maya smiled back. She was scared, but she didn’t give up.

That night, Maya learned that being brave doesn’t mean you are not afraid.

Arti Bahasa Indonesia

Suatu malam, seorang gadis kecil bernama Maya berjalan pulang bersama adik laki-lakinya.

Tiba-tiba, lampu jalan padam. Jalan menjadi gelap dan sunyi.

Adiknya memegang tangannya erat. “Aku takut,” katanya.

Maya juga merasa takut, tetapi dia mencoba tetap tenang.

“Jangan khawatir, aku di sini,” katanya.

Mereka terus berjalan perlahan. Angin bertiup, dan suara aneh datang dari pepohonan.

Maya melihat sekeliling dengan hati-hati dan terus berjalan ke depan.

Beberapa menit kemudian, mereka akhirnya melihat rumah mereka.

Adiknya tersenyum dan berkata, “Kamu sangat berani.”

Maya tersenyum kembali. Dia takut, tetapi dia tidak menyerah.

Malam itu, Maya belajar bahwa menjadi berani bukan berarti tidak merasa takut.

stories.title: The Magic Pencil
stories.subtitle: Pensil Ajaib
stories.markdown:
# The Magic Pencil

Pensil Ajaib

English Story

One day, Leo found a strange pencil on his desk. It looked old but shiny.

When he picked it up, he felt something different. “This is cool,” he said.

Leo started drawing a small apple in his notebook. Suddenly, the apple appeared on his desk.

“Wow, this is amazing!” Leo shouted.

Excited, he drew a toy car. In a second, it became real. Everything he drew came to life.

Leo was on cloud nine. He couldn’t believe what was happening.

But then he had a thought. “What if I draw too much?” he said.

He decided to use the pencil carefully and only for good things.

That day, Leo learned that power must be used wisely.

Arti Bahasa Indonesia

Suatu hari, Leo menemukan sebuah pensil aneh di mejanya. Pensil itu terlihat tua tetapi berkilau.

Ketika dia mengambilnya, dia merasakan sesuatu yang berbeda. “Ini keren,” katanya.

Leo mulai menggambar sebuah apel kecil di bukunya. Tiba-tiba, apel itu muncul di mejanya.

“Wow, ini luar biasa!” teriak Leo.

Dengan penuh semangat, dia menggambar mobil mainan. Dalam sekejap, benda itu menjadi nyata. Semua yang dia gambar menjadi hidup.

Leo sangat bahagia. Dia tidak percaya dengan apa yang terjadi.

Tapi kemudian dia berpikir. “Bagaimana kalau aku menggambar terlalu banyak?” katanya.

Dia memutuskan untuk menggunakan pensil itu dengan hati-hati dan hanya untuk hal baik.

Hari itu, Leo belajar bahwa kekuatan harus digunakan dengan bijak.

stories.title: The Day I Got Lost
stories.subtitle: Hari Saat Aku Tersesat
stories.markdown:
# The Day I Got Lost

Hari Saat Aku Tersesat

English Story

One afternoon, I went to the market with my mother. It was crowded and noisy.

While she was buying vegetables, I saw a toy shop nearby. I walked toward it without thinking.

After a few minutes, I turned around. My mother was gone.

I started to feel scared. Everything looked the same, and I didn’t know where to go.

I walked quickly, trying to find her. “Mom?” I called, but there was no answer.

My heart was beating fast. I felt lost and confused.

Then I saw a security guard. I walked to him and said, “Excuse me, I can’t find my mother.”

The guard smiled kindly and helped me. He used a microphone to call my mother.

A few minutes later, my mother came running toward me and hugged me tightly.

“Don’t go away like that again,” she said.

I nodded. That day, I learned to stay close and be careful.

Arti Bahasa Indonesia

Suatu sore, aku pergi ke pasar bersama ibuku. Tempat itu ramai dan bising.

Saat ibu sedang membeli sayuran, aku melihat toko mainan di dekatnya. Aku berjalan ke sana tanpa berpikir.

Beberapa menit kemudian, aku berbalik. Ibuku sudah tidak ada.

Aku mulai merasa takut. Semua terlihat sama, dan aku tidak tahu harus ke mana.

Aku berjalan cepat, mencoba mencarinya. “Ibu?” aku memanggil, tetapi tidak ada jawaban.

Jantungku berdegup kencang. Aku merasa tersesat dan bingung.

Kemudian aku melihat seorang petugas keamanan. Aku menghampirinya dan berkata, “Permisi, saya tidak bisa menemukan ibu saya.”

Petugas itu tersenyum ramah dan membantuku. Dia menggunakan mikrofon untuk memanggil ibuku.

Beberapa menit kemudian, ibuku datang berlari ke arahku dan memelukku erat.

“Jangan pergi seperti itu lagi,” katanya.

Aku mengangguk. Hari itu, aku belajar untuk tetap dekat dan berhati-hati.

stories.title: The Kind Stranger
stories.subtitle: Orang Asing yang Baik Hati
stories.markdown:
# The Kind Stranger

Orang Asing yang Baik Hati

English Story

One rainy afternoon, Daniel was walking home from school. He didn’t bring an umbrella.

The rain became heavier, and his clothes were completely wet.

He tried to run, but the road was slippery. Suddenly, he slipped and fell.

“Ouch!” he said softly.

A man nearby saw him and quickly came over. “Are you okay?” he asked.

Daniel nodded, but he still looked uncomfortable.

The man gave him his umbrella and said, “You can use this.”

Daniel was surprised. “But what about you?” he asked.

The man smiled and said, “I’ll be fine.”

Daniel thanked him and walked home safely.

That day, Daniel learned that kindness can come from anyone, even a stranger.

Arti Bahasa Indonesia

Suatu sore yang hujan, Daniel berjalan pulang dari sekolah. Dia tidak membawa payung.

Hujan semakin deras, dan pakaiannya menjadi basah kuyup.

Dia mencoba berlari, tetapi jalanan licin. Tiba-tiba, dia terpeleset dan jatuh.

“Aduh!” katanya pelan.

Seorang pria di dekatnya melihat dan segera menghampirinya. “Apakah kamu baik-baik saja?” tanyanya.

Daniel mengangguk, tetapi dia masih terlihat tidak nyaman.

Pria itu memberikan payungnya dan berkata, “Kamu bisa menggunakan ini.”

Daniel terkejut. “Lalu bagaimana dengan Anda?” tanyanya.

Pria itu tersenyum dan berkata, “Saya akan baik-baik saja.”

Daniel berterima kasih dan berjalan pulang dengan selamat.

Hari itu, Daniel belajar bahwa kebaikan bisa datang dari siapa saja, bahkan dari orang asing.

stories.title: The Talking Tree
stories.subtitle: Pohon yang Bisa Berbicara
stories.markdown:
# The Talking Tree

Pohon yang Bisa Berbicara

English Story

One afternoon, Ben was walking in a quiet park near his house. He liked to spend time alone there.

As he sat under a large tree, he heard a soft voice. “Why do you look so sad?”

Ben looked around, but no one was there.

“Down here,” the voice said again.

Ben looked at the tree in surprise. “Did you just speak?” he asked.

“Yes,” the tree replied gently. “I can hear your thoughts.”

Ben felt nervous, but he decided to speak. “I have no friends,” he said quietly.

The tree said, “You just need to open your heart and talk to others.”

Ben thought for a moment. The next day, he tried to talk to someone at school.

To his surprise, the boy smiled and talked back.

Ben returned to the tree and said, “Thank you.”

The tree did not speak again, but Ben smiled. He already knew what to do.

Arti Bahasa Indonesia

Suatu sore, Ben berjalan di taman yang sepi dekat rumahnya. Dia suka menghabiskan waktu sendirian di sana.

Saat dia duduk di bawah pohon besar, dia mendengar suara lembut. “Mengapa kamu terlihat sedih?”

Ben melihat ke sekeliling, tetapi tidak ada siapa pun.

“Di sini,” kata suara itu lagi.

Ben melihat pohon itu dengan terkejut. “Apakah kamu baru saja berbicara?” tanyanya.

“Ya,” jawab pohon itu dengan lembut. “Aku bisa mendengar pikiranmu.”

Ben merasa gugup, tetapi dia memutuskan untuk berbicara. “Aku tidak punya teman,” katanya pelan.

Pohon itu berkata, “Kamu hanya perlu membuka hatimu dan berbicara dengan orang lain.”

Ben berpikir sejenak. Keesokan harinya, dia mencoba berbicara dengan seseorang di sekolah.

Yang mengejutkan, anak itu tersenyum dan membalas pembicaraan.

Ben kembali ke pohon itu dan berkata, “Terima kasih.”

Pohon itu tidak berbicara lagi, tetapi Ben tersenyum. Dia sudah tahu apa yang harus dilakukan.

# My First Time on Stage

Pengalaman Pertamaku di Atas Panggung

English Story

It was my first time standing on a stage. My hands were shaking, and my heart was beating fast.

I looked at the audience and felt very nervous. “I can’t do this,” I whispered.

My teacher smiled and said, “You practiced well, didn’t you?”

I took a deep breath and walked to the center of the stage.

At first, my voice was small. But slowly, I began to feel more confident.

I remembered my practice and continued speaking.

After a few minutes, everything felt easier. I was no longer afraid.

When I finished, the audience clapped loudly.

I felt so proud. I was on cloud nine.

That day, I learned that being brave can change everything.

Aku menarik napas dalam-dalam dan berjalan ke tengah panggung.

Aku mengingat latihanku dan terus berbicara.

Beberapa menit kemudian, semuanya terasa lebih mudah. Aku tidak takut lagi.

Ketika aku selesai, penonton bertepuk tangan dengan meriah.

Aku merasa sangat bangga. Aku sangat bahagia.

Hari itu, aku belajar bahwa keberanian bisa mengubah segalanya.

stories.title: The Hidden Treasure Map
stories.subtitle: Peta Harta Karun Tersembunyi
stories.markdown:
# The Hidden Treasure Map

Peta Harta Karun Tersembunyi

English Story

One day, Tom and his sister Lily were cleaning their attic. It was full of old boxes and dusty books.

While searching, Tom found a small rolled paper inside a wooden box.

“What is this?” he asked.

Lily opened it carefully. It was an old map with a red X on it.

“This looks like a treasure map!” she said excitedly.

They decided to follow the map. It led them to a small forest behind their house.

They walked past tall trees and crossed a narrow path.

After a while, they found the spot marked with an X.

Tom started digging, and Lily helped him.

Finally, they found a small metal box.

They were so excited. They were on cloud nine.

Inside the box, they found old coins and a note that said, “Adventure is the real treasure.”

Tom and Lily smiled. The journey was more fun than the treasure itself.

Arti Bahasa Indonesia

Suatu hari, Tom dan adiknya Lily sedang membersihkan loteng. Tempat itu penuh dengan kotak lama dan buku berdebu.

Saat mencari, Tom menemukan selembar kertas gulung kecil di dalam kotak kayu.

“Apa ini?” tanyanya.

Lily membukanya dengan hati-hati. Itu adalah peta lama dengan tanda X merah di atasnya.

“Ini terlihat seperti peta harta karun!” katanya dengan semangat.

Mereka memutuskan untuk mengikuti peta itu. Peta itu membawa mereka ke hutan kecil di belakang rumah mereka.

Mereka berjalan melewati pohon-pohon tinggi dan melintasi jalan sempit.

Setelah beberapa saat, mereka menemukan tempat yang ditandai dengan X.

Tom mulai menggali, dan Lily membantunya.

Akhirnya, mereka menemukan sebuah kotak logam kecil.

stories.title: A Rainy Day Adventure
stories.subtitle: Petualangan di Hari Hujan
stories.markdown:
# A Rainy Day Adventure

Petualangan di Hari Hujan

English Story

It was raining heavily that afternoon. Jake and his sister Emma stayed at home.

“This is boring,” Jake said while looking outside.

Emma smiled and said, “Let’s make our own adventure.”

They built a small tent using blankets and chairs in the living room.

Then, they used a flashlight to pretend they were in a dark forest.

“Watch out! There’s something behind you!” Emma said playfully.

Jake laughed. “Nice try!”

They imagined many things and created their own world.

After a while, the rain stopped. Sunlight came through the window.

“Wow, that was fun,” Jake said.

Emma nodded. “Yeah, we made the best out of it.”

They were on cloud nine, even without going outside.

Arti Bahasa Indonesia

Sore itu hujan turun dengan deras. Jake dan adiknya Emma tinggal di rumah.

“Ini membosankan,” kata Jake sambil melihat ke luar.

Emma tersenyum dan berkata, “Ayo kita buat petualangan kita sendiri.”

Mereka membuat tenda kecil menggunakan selimut dan kursi di ruang tamu.

Kemudian, mereka menggunakan senter dan berpura-pura berada di hutan gelap.

“Awas! Ada sesuatu di belakangmu!” kata Emma dengan bercanda.

Jake tertawa. “Coba lagi!”

Mereka membayangkan banyak hal dan menciptakan dunia mereka sendiri.

Setelah beberapa saat, hujan berhenti. Sinar matahari masuk melalui jendela.

“Wow, itu menyenangkan,” kata Jake.

Emma mengangguk. “Ya, kita membuat yang terbaik dari situasi ini.”

Mereka sangat bahagia, meskipun tidak pergi ke luar.

stories.title: The Broken Bicycle

# The Broken Bicycle

Sepeda yang Rusak

English Story

One afternoon, Ryan was riding his bicycle in the park. He felt happy and free.

Suddenly, he heard a strange sound. “Crack!”

His bicycle stopped, and he almost fell.

“Oh no, my bike is broken,” he said.

He checked the wheel and saw that it was damaged.

Ryan felt sad. He couldn’t ride it anymore.

Then his older brother came and said, “You can fix it, can’t you?”

Ryan wasn’t sure, but he decided to try.

They worked together and slowly fixed the bicycle.

After some time, the bike was ready again.

Ryan smiled. He was back on track.

He rode his bicycle again, feeling proud of himself.

That day, he learned that problems can be solved with effort.

Arti Bahasa Indonesia

Suatu sore, Ryan sedang mengendarai sepedanya di taman. Dia merasa senang dan bebas.

Tiba-tiba, dia mendengar suara aneh. “Krek!”

Sepedanya berhenti, dan dia hampir jatuh.

“Oh tidak, sepedaku rusak,” katanya.

Dia memeriksa roda dan melihat bahwa roda itu rusak.

Ryan merasa sedih. Dia tidak bisa mengendarainya lagi.

Kemudian kakaknya datang dan berkata, “Kamu bisa memperbaikinya, bukan?”

Ryan tidak yakin, tetapi dia memutuskan untuk mencoba.

Mereka bekerja bersama dan perlahan memperbaiki sepeda itu.

Setelah beberapa waktu, sepeda itu siap digunakan kembali.

Ryan tersenyum. Dia kembali ke jalurnya.

Dia mengendarai sepedanya lagi, merasa bangga pada dirinya sendiri.

Hari itu, dia belajar bahwa masalah bisa diselesaikan dengan usaha.

# The Dream That Came True

Mimpi yang Menjadi Kenyataan

English Story

Since she was a child, Anna dreamed of becoming a singer.

She practiced every day, even when no one was listening.

Sometimes, she felt tired and wanted to give up.

But her mother always said, “You believe in your dream, don’t you?”

Anna nodded and kept practicing.

One day, she joined a singing competition at school.

She felt nervous, but she tried her best on stage.

When she finished, the audience clapped loudly.

In the end, Anna won first place.

She was over the moon.

Her dream started to come true because she never gave up.

Tetapi ibunya selalu berkata, “Kamu percaya pada mimpimu, bukan?”

Anna mengangguk dan terus berlatih.

Suatu hari, dia mengikuti lomba menyanyi di sekolah.

Dia merasa gugup, tetapi dia mencoba yang terbaik di atas panggung.

Ketika dia selesai, penonton bertepuk tangan dengan meriah.

Pada akhirnya, Anna memenangkan juara pertama.

Mimpinya mulai menjadi kenyataan karena dia tidak pernah menyerah.

stories.title: The Mysterious Neighbor

stories.markdown:
# The Mysterious Neighbor

Tetangga yang Misterius

English Story

A new neighbor moved into the house next door. No one knew much about him.

He rarely came outside, and the lights in his house were always dim.

Tom felt curious. “He looks strange,” he said to his friend.

One evening, Tom saw the neighbor carrying a large box into his house.

“What’s inside that box?” Tom wondered.

The next day, Tom decided to get to the bottom of it.

He walked closer to the house and looked through the window.

Suddenly, the door opened.

“Can I help you?” the neighbor asked calmly.

Tom felt nervous. “I… I was just curious,” he said.

The man smiled and invited him inside.

To Tom’s surprise, the house was full of paintings and art supplies.

“I’m an artist,” the man said.

Tom felt relieved and a little embarrassed.

He realized that things are not always what they seem.

Arti Bahasa Indonesia

Seorang tetangga baru pindah ke rumah sebelah. Tidak ada yang tahu banyak tentang dirinya.

Dia jarang keluar rumah, dan lampu di rumahnya selalu redup.

Tom merasa penasaran. “Dia terlihat aneh,” katanya kepada temannya.

Suatu malam, Tom melihat tetangga itu membawa kotak besar ke dalam rumahnya.

“Apa isi kotak itu?” pikir Tom.

Keesokan harinya, Tom memutuskan untuk mencari tahu.

Dia berjalan mendekati rumah itu dan melihat melalui jendela.

Tiba-tiba, pintu terbuka.

“Ada yang bisa saya bantu?” tanya tetangga itu dengan tenang.

Tom merasa gugup. “A… aku hanya penasaran,” katanya.

Pria itu tersenyum dan mengundangnya masuk.

Yang mengejutkan, rumah itu penuh dengan lukisan dan alat seni.

“Saya seorang seniman,” kata pria itu.

Tom merasa lega dan sedikit malu.

Dia menyadari bahwa sesuatu tidak selalu seperti yang terlihat.

# The School Competition

English Story

There was a big competition at school. Students from every class joined the event.

Kevin decided to participate in the quiz competition.

He studied hard every day and prepared himself well.

On the day of the competition, he felt nervous.

“You can do it,” his friend said.

The competition started, and the questions were not easy.

Kevin tried his best to answer each one carefully.

At one point, he almost gave up, but he kept going.

Finally, the results were announced.

“Kevin is the winner!” the teacher said.

Kevin was so happy. “Wow, I did it!” he said.

All his hard work paid off.

That day, Kevin learned that effort and persistence bring success.

# The Helpful Robot

Robot yang Suka Menolong

English Story

In the future, there was a small robot named Robo. He lived with a boy named Alex.

Robo was designed to help people with daily tasks.

One day, Alex forgot to do his homework.

“Oh no, I’m in trouble,” Alex said.

Robo quickly came and said, “Don’t worry, I can help you.”

He organized Alex’s books and helped him understand the lesson.

“Thanks, Robo. You’re awesome!” Alex said.

Robo beeped happily.

The next day, Alex helped his friend who had the same problem.

Robo watched and said, “Helping others is the best thing you can do.”

# A Letter from the Future

Surat dari Masa Depan

English Story

One night, Liam found a strange letter on his desk.

It had his name on it, but he didn’t remember writing it.

He opened the letter slowly and began to read.

“Dear Liam, this is you from the future,” the letter said.

Liam was confused. “Is this real?” he whispered.

The letter continued, “Don’t be afraid of making mistakes. Keep learning and never give up.”

It also said, “You are stronger than you think, aren’t you?”

Liam felt something change inside him.

The next day, he tried harder at school and helped his friends.

He remembered every word from the letter.

Slowly, his life started to improve.

Liam realized that the letter gave him a push in the right direction.

Maybe the future was not something to wait for, but something to create.

Arti Bahasa Indonesia

Suatu malam, Liam menemukan sebuah surat aneh di mejanya.

Surat itu bertuliskan namanya, tetapi dia tidak ingat pernah menulisnya.

“Dear Liam, ini adalah kamu dari masa depan,” isi surat itu.

Liam merasa bingung. “Apakah ini nyata?” bisiknya.

Surat itu berlanjut, “Jangan takut membuat kesalahan. Teruslah belajar dan jangan pernah menyerah.”

Surat itu juga mengatakan, “Kamu lebih kuat dari yang kamu pikirkan, bukan?”

Liam merasakan sesuatu berubah dalam dirinya.

Keesokan harinya, dia berusaha lebih keras di sekolah dan membantu teman-temannya.

Dia mengingat setiap kata dari surat itu.

Perlahan, hidupnya mulai membaik.

Liam menyadari bahwa surat itu memberinya dorongan ke arah yang benar.

# FUN FACTS – Amazing World Facts

Octopuses Have Three Hearts (Gurita Memiliki Tiga Jantung)

Imagine having three hearts in your body! Sounds crazy, right? But this is real for octopuses.

Reading Text

Did you know that octopuses have three hearts? Two hearts pump blood to the gills, while one heart pumps blood to the rest of the body.

When an octopus swims, the heart that sends blood to the body stops beating. That is why octopuses prefer crawling instead of swimming.

Octopuses are also very intelligent animals. They can solve problems and escape from difficult situations.

Grammar Highlight

**Octopuses have three hearts

have** digunakan untuk menunjukkan kepemilikan (possession).**
Contoh lain:

- I have a book.

- She has a cat.

Gunakan have/has** untuk menyatakan sesuatu yang dimiliki.

Bahasa Indonesia

Tahukah kamu bahwa gurita memiliki tiga jantung? Dua jantung memompa darah ke insang, sementara satu jantung memompa darah ke seluruh tubuh.

Saat gurita berenang, jantung yang mengalirkan darah ke tubuh berhenti berdetak. Itulah sebabnya gurita lebih suka merangkak daripada berenang.

Gurita juga merupakan hewan yang sangat cerdas. Mereka dapat memecahkan masalah dan keluar dari situasi sulit.

Summary

• Gurita memiliki tiga jantung.

• Dua jantung untuk insang, satu untuk tubuh.

• Gurita lebih suka merangkak karena berenang melelahkan.

• Gurita adalah hewan yang cerdas.

# FUN FACTS – Amazing World Facts

Bananas Are Berries (Pisang adalah Buah Beri)

Wait... bananas are berries, but strawberries are not! Sounds strange, right?

Reading Text

Many people think bananas are just regular fruits. However, bananas are actually classified as berries.

In botany, a berry is a fruit that develops from one flower with one ovary. Bananas meet this definition, but strawberries do not.

Strawberries come from multiple ovaries, which means they are not true berries. This makes bananas more special than we think!

Grammar Highlight

**Bananas are berries

are** adalah bentuk dari **to be** untuk subjek jamak (plural).**
Contoh lain:

- They are students.

- Apples are fruits.

Gunakan am / is / are** untuk menjelaskan sesuatu.

Bahasa Indonesia

Banyak orang berpikir bahwa pisang hanyalah buah biasa. Namun, pisang sebenarnya diklasifikasikan sebagai buah beri.

Dalam ilmu botani, buah beri adalah buah yang berkembang dari satu bunga dengan satu ovarium. Pisang memenuhi definisi ini, tetapi stroberi tidak.

Stroberi berasal dari banyak ovarium, sehingga bukan buah beri sejati. Hal ini membuat pisang lebih spesial dari yang kita kira!

Summary

• Pisang adalah buah beri.

• Buah beri berasal dari satu bunga dengan satu ovarium.

• Stroberi bukan buah beri.

• Pisang lebih unik dari yang kita kira.

# FUN FACTS – Amazing World Facts

Honey Never Spoils (Madu Tidak Pernah Basi)

Imagine eating food that is 3,000 years old and still safe! That is how amazing honey is.

Reading Text

Honey is one of the few foods that never spoils. Scientists have found jars of honey in ancient tombs that are more than 3,000 years old.

Surprisingly, the honey was still safe to eat. This happens because honey has very low water content and natural substances that stop bacteria from growing.

These special properties make honey last for a very long time without going bad.

Grammar Highlight

**Honey never spoils

never** digunakan untuk menyatakan sesuatu yang tidak pernah terjadi.**
Contoh lain:

- I never eat junk food.

- She never wakes up late.

Gunakan never** untuk menekankan frekuensi nol (tidak pernah).

Bahasa Indonesia

Madu adalah salah satu makanan yang tidak pernah basi. Para ilmuwan menemukan toples madu di makam kuno yang berusia lebih dari 3.000 tahun.

Menariknya, madu tersebut masih aman untuk dimakan. Hal ini terjadi karena madu memiliki kadar air yang sangat rendah dan zat alami yang mencegah bakteri tumbuh.

Sifat khusus ini membuat madu dapat bertahan sangat lama tanpa rusak.

Summary

• Madu tidak pernah basi.

• Madu ditemukan di makam kuno berusia 3.000 tahun.

• Madu aman dimakan karena sifat alaminya.

• Madu memiliki kadar air rendah dan mencegah bakteri.

# FUN FACTS – Amazing World Facts

Sharks Are Older Than Trees (Hiu Lebih Tua dari Pohon)

Imagine swimming with an animal that existed before trees! Sharks have been around for a very long time.

Reading Text

Sharks are one of the oldest animals on Earth. They existed more than 400 million years ago.

Trees, on the other hand, appeared about 350 million years ago. This means sharks lived before trees even existed.

These ancient creatures have survived many changes on Earth, making them strong and adaptable animals.

Grammar Highlight

**Sharks are older than trees

older than** digunakan untuk membandingkan dua hal (comparative).**
Contoh lain:

- This book is older than that book.

- Elephants are bigger than dogs.

Gunakan -er + than** untuk membuat perbandingan sederhana.

Bahasa Indonesia

Hiu adalah salah satu hewan tertua di Bumi. Mereka sudah ada lebih dari 400 juta tahun yang lalu.

Sementara itu, pohon muncul sekitar 350 juta tahun yang lalu. Ini berarti hiu sudah hidup sebelum pohon ada.

Makhluk purba ini telah bertahan dari banyak perubahan di Bumi, menjadikannya hewan yang kuat dan mudah beradaptasi.

Summary

• Hiu adalah hewan yang sangat tua.

• Hiu sudah ada lebih dari 400 juta tahun lalu.

• Pohon muncul setelah hiu.

• Hiu adalah hewan yang kuat dan mampu beradaptasi.

# FUN FACTS – Amazing World Facts

A Day on Venus Is Longer Than a Year (Satu Hari di Venus Lebih Lama dari Satu Tahun)

Imagine a day that lasts longer than a whole year! That’s exactly what happens on Venus.

Reading Text

Venus is one of the most interesting planets in our solar system. A single day on Venus lasts about 243 Earth days.

However, a year on Venus is only about 225 Earth days. This means a day on Venus is longer than a year on the same planet.

This happens because Venus rotates very slowly on its axis. It also rotates in the opposite direction compared to most planets.

Grammar Highlight

**A day on Venus is longer than a year

longer than** digunakan untuk membandingkan dua hal (comparative).**
Contoh lain:

- This road is longer than that road.

- A week is longer than a day.

Gunakan -er + than** untuk membuat perbandingan sederhana.

Bahasa Indonesia

Venus adalah salah satu planet paling menarik di tata surya kita. Satu hari di Venus berlangsung sekitar 243 hari di Bumi.

Namun, satu tahun di Venus hanya sekitar 225 hari di Bumi. Ini berarti satu hari di Venus lebih lama daripada satu tahun di planet tersebut.

Hal ini terjadi karena Venus berputar sangat lambat pada porosnya. Venus juga berputar ke arah yang berlawanan dibandingkan kebanyakan planet.

Summary

• Satu hari di Venus lebih lama dari satu tahun.

• 1 hari Venus = 243 hari Bumi.

• 1 tahun Venus = 225 hari Bumi.

• Venus berputar sangat lambat.

# FUN FACTS – Amazing World Facts

Humans Share DNA with Bananas (Manusia Berbagi DNA dengan Pisang)

What if I told you that you share DNA with a banana? Sounds unbelievable, but it’s true!

Reading Text

Humans and bananas share about 60% of the same DNA. DNA is the basic instruction that tells living things how to grow and function.

This does not mean humans are similar to bananas. It only means that some basic biological processes are shared between many living things.

All living organisms on Earth are connected in some way, which is why we can find similarities even between humans and plants.

Grammar Highlight

**Humans share DNA with bananas

share** berarti berbagi sesuatu dengan orang lain atau benda lain.**
Contoh lain:

- I share my food with my friend.

- They share the same idea.

Bahasa Indonesia

Ini tidak berarti manusia mirip dengan pisang. Hal ini hanya menunjukkan bahwa beberapa proses biologis dasar dimiliki oleh banyak makhluk hidup.

Semua organisme hidup di Bumi saling terhubung dalam beberapa cara, sehingga kita dapat menemukan kesamaan bahkan antara manusia dan tumbuhan.

Summary

• Manusia dan pisang berbagi sekitar 60% DNA.

• DNA adalah instruksi dasar makhluk hidup.

• Banyak makhluk hidup memiliki proses biologis yang sama.

• Semua makhluk hidup saling terhubung.

Some turtles have a special ability to breathe through their cloaca, which is an opening at the back of their body.

The Eiffel Tower in Paris can grow taller during the summer. This happens because metal expands when it gets hot.

Dolphins are very intelligent animals. They use unique sounds, called signature whistles, to identify each other.

# FUN FACTS – Amazing World Facts

Your Brain Uses a Lot of Energy (Otakmu Menggunakan Banyak Energi)

Even when you’re resting, your brain is working hard and using a lot of energy!

Reading Text

The human brain is one of the most important organs in the body. Although it only makes up about 2% of your body weight, it uses around 20% of your total energy.

Your brain is always active, even when you are sleeping. It controls your thoughts, movements, and body functions all the time.

Because of this, your brain needs a constant supply of oxygen and nutrients to stay healthy and work properly.

**Your brain uses a lot of energy

Karena itu, otak membutuhkan pasokan oksigen dan nutrisi yang terus-menerus agar tetap sehat dan bekerja dengan baik.

Summary

• Otak hanya 2% dari berat tubuh.

• Menggunakan sekitar 20% energi tubuh.

The universe is incredibly vast. Scientists estimate that there are more stars in the universe than grains of sand on all the beaches on Earth.

Butterflies are fascinating insects. One of their most interesting abilities is that they can taste using their feet.

• Koala bisa tidur hingga 20 jam sehari.

The Moon is not as quiet as it seems. It experiences small movements called moonquakes.

Bulan tidak setenang yang terlihat. Bulan mengalami getaran kecil yang disebut gempa bulan.

Berbeda dengan gempa bumi, gempa bulan dapat berlangsung lebih lama karena tidak ada air untuk menyerap getaran.

Summary

• Terjadi karena suhu dan gravitasi.

fun_facts.title: Cats Sleep for Most of Their Lives
fun_facts.subtitle: Kucing Tidur Sebagian Besar Hidupnya
fun_facts.markdown:
READING ZONE

# FUN FACTS – Amazing World Facts

Cats Sleep for Most of Their Lives (Kucing Tidur Sebagian Besar Hidup Mereka)

Cats are true sleep experts—they spend most of their lives sleeping!

Reading Text

Cats are known for their love of sleep. On average, they can sleep between 12 to 16 hours a day.

Some cats sleep even longer, especially kittens and older cats. Sleeping helps them save energy for hunting and playing.

Because of this, cats spend a large part of their lives resting and relaxing.

Grammar Highlight

**Cats sleep for most of their lives

most of** berarti “sebagian besar”.**
Digunakan untuk menunjukkan jumlah besar dari sesuatu.

Contoh lain:

- Most of the students passed.

- Most of the time, I study at night.

Gunakan most of** untuk menyatakan mayoritas.

Bahasa Indonesia

Kucing dikenal karena suka tidur. Rata-rata, mereka bisa tidur antara 12 hingga 16 jam sehari.

Beberapa kucing bahkan tidur lebih lama, terutama anak kucing dan kucing tua. Tidur membantu mereka menghemat energi untuk berburu dan bermain.

Karena itu, kucing menghabiskan sebagian besar hidup mereka untuk beristirahat.

Summary

• Kucing tidur 12–16 jam sehari.

• Anak dan kucing tua tidur lebih lama.

• Tidur membantu menghemat energi.

• Sebagian besar hidup dihabiskan untuk tidur.

SPEECH LESSON

# Education: The Bridge to a Brighter Future

Pendidikan: Jembatan Menuju Masa Depan yang Lebih Cerah

English Speech

**Good morning, honorable judges, respected teachers, and my beloved friends.**

First of all, let us praise and thank God Almighty for giving us health, strength, and the opportunity to gather here today.

It is a great honor for me to stand in front of you and deliver a speech with the title:
**"Education: The Bridge to a Brighter Future."**

Ladies and gentlemen,

Education is one of the most powerful tools in human life. It is not only about learning from books, memorizing formulas, or passing exams. Education is about developing our knowledge, improving our skills, building our character, and preparing ourselves to face the challenges of the future.

Imagine a person standing on one side of a deep river. On the other side, there is a beautiful land full of opportunities, dreams, and success. But without a bridge, it is impossible to reach that place.

Education is that bridge.

It connects our dreams with reality. It helps us move from ignorance to knowledge, from weakness to strength, and from uncertainty to confidence.

Education gives us knowledge, builds our character, and creates opportunities. Through education, we can improve ourselves and contribute to society.

As students, we have a great responsibility. We should appreciate the opportunity to learn, respect our teachers, and continue improving ourselves.

Remember, every book we read, every lesson we learn, and every effort we make today is an investment for our future.

Education is more than just a journey to get a certificate. It is a lifelong process that shapes who we are and who we will become.

**Thank you very much for your attention.**

Arti Bahasa Indonesia

Selamat pagi para juri yang terhormat, guru-guru yang saya hormati, dan teman-teman yang saya cintai.

Pertama-tama, marilah kita panjatkan puji dan syukur kepada Tuhan Yang Maha Esa karena telah memberikan kesehatan, kekuatan, dan kesempatan untuk berkumpul hari ini.

Merupakan kehormatan besar bagi saya untuk berdiri di depan kalian dan menyampaikan pidato dengan judul:
**"Pendidikan: Jembatan Menuju Masa Depan yang Lebih Cerah."**

Pendidikan adalah salah satu alat paling kuat dalam kehidupan manusia. Pendidikan bukan hanya tentang belajar dari buku, menghafal rumus, atau lulus ujian. Pendidikan adalah tentang mengembangkan pengetahuan, meningkatkan kemampuan, membangun karakter, dan mempersiapkan diri menghadapi tantangan masa depan.

Bayangkan seseorang berdiri di satu sisi sungai yang dalam. Di sisi lain terdapat tempat indah yang penuh dengan kesempatan, impian, dan kesuksesan. Namun tanpa jembatan, sulit untuk mencapai tempat tersebut.

Pendidikan adalah jembatan itu.

Pendidikan menghubungkan impian kita dengan kenyataan. Pendidikan membantu kita berubah dari ketidaktahuan menjadi pengetahuan, dari kelemahan menjadi kekuatan, dan dari ketidakpastian menjadi kepercayaan diri.

speeches.title: Clean Environment, Healthy Life: Our Responsibility Begins Today

speeches.markdown:
SPEECH LESSON

# Clean Environment, Healthy Life: Our Responsibility Begins Today

Lingkungan Bersih, Hidup Sehat: Tanggung Jawab Kita Dimulai Hari Ini

English Speech

**Good morning, honorable judges, respected teachers, and my dear friends.**

First of all, let us express our gratitude to God Almighty for giving us health, happiness, and the opportunity to gather together today.

It is a great honor for me to stand in front of you and deliver a speech entitled:
**"Clean Environment, Healthy Life: Our Responsibility Begins Today."**

Ladies and gentlemen,

The environment is one of the most important parts of our life. It is the place where we live, grow, and build our future. A clean environment provides fresh air, clean water, and a healthy place for everyone.

However, today our environment faces many serious problems. Pollution, plastic waste, deforestation, and careless human activities have damaged nature.

If we continue ignoring these problems, our future generations will suffer the consequences.

A clean environment does not happen by itself. It requires awareness, cooperation, and responsibility from all of us.

The first step to protecting our environment begins with small actions.

Throwing garbage into the right place, reducing the use of plastic, saving water, planting trees, and keeping our surroundings clean are simple habits that can create a big impact.

Many people think that one small action cannot change the world. But we must remember that a thousand small actions can create a great change.

A clean environment also creates a healthy life. When our surroundings are clean, we reduce the risk of diseases and create a better place to live.

As students, we have an important role in maintaining the environment. We can start from our school, our home, and our community.

Let us stop waiting for others to take action. Change begins with ourselves.

Remember, the Earth is not only our home today, but also the home of future generations.

**Thank you very much for your attention.**

Arti Bahasa Indonesia

Selamat pagi para juri yang terhormat, guru-guru yang saya hormati, dan teman-teman yang saya cintai.

Pertama-tama, marilah kita mengucapkan rasa syukur kepada Tuhan Yang Maha Esa karena telah memberikan kesehatan, kebahagiaan, dan kesempatan untuk berkumpul bersama hari ini.

Merupakan kehormatan besar bagi saya untuk berdiri di depan kalian dan menyampaikan pidato dengan judul:
**"Lingkungan Bersih, Hidup Sehat: Tanggung Jawab Kita Dimulai Hari Ini."**

Lingkungan adalah salah satu bagian terpenting dalam kehidupan kita. Lingkungan adalah tempat kita hidup, tumbuh, dan membangun masa depan.

Namun saat ini lingkungan kita menghadapi banyak masalah serius. Polusi, sampah plastik, penebangan hutan, dan aktivitas manusia yang tidak peduli telah merusak alam.

Lingkungan yang bersih tidak terjadi dengan sendirinya. Dibutuhkan kesadaran, kerja sama, dan tanggung jawab dari kita semua.

Langkah pertama untuk melindungi lingkungan dimulai dari tindakan kecil.

Membuang sampah pada tempatnya, mengurangi penggunaan plastik, menghemat air, menanam pohon, dan menjaga kebersihan sekitar adalah kebiasaan sederhana yang dapat memberikan dampak besar.

Sebagai siswa, kita memiliki peran penting dalam menjaga lingkungan. Kita dapat memulainya dari sekolah, rumah, dan lingkungan sekitar.

Jangan menunggu orang lain untuk bertindak. Perubahan dimulai dari diri kita sendiri.

# Protecting Our Planet: A Promise for Future Generations

**Good morning, honorable judges, respected teachers, and my dear friends.**

First of all, I would like to express my gratitude to God Almighty for giving us health, strength, and the chance to gather here today.

It is a great honor for me to stand before you and deliver a speech entitled:
**"Protecting Our Planet: A Promise for Future Generations."**

Ladies and gentlemen,

The Earth is our only home. It provides everything we need to survive, including air, water, food, and natural resources. However, our planet is facing many environmental challenges caused by human activities.

Climate change, pollution, deforestation, and excessive waste have become serious threats to our environment. These problems do not only affect us today, but also threaten the lives of future generations.

Therefore, protecting our planet is not only a responsibility for governments or organizations. It is a responsibility for every one of us.

Small actions can create big changes. Saving electricity, reducing plastic use, recycling waste, planting trees, and protecting wildlife are simple steps that everyone can do.

Some people may think that their actions are too small to make a difference. However, when millions of people take small actions together, they can create a powerful movement for change.

Ladies and gentlemen,

The future of our planet depends on what we do today. We cannot continue taking resources from the Earth without thinking about tomorrow.

We must learn to live in harmony with nature and respect the environment around us.

As young people, we are the future leaders of this world. We have the power to create positive changes and protect the planet for the next generation.

Let us make a promise today: to care for our Earth, to protect nature, and to build a greener future.

**Thank you very much for your attention.**

Tindakan kecil dapat menciptakan perubahan besar. Menghemat listrik, mengurangi penggunaan plastik, mendaur ulang sampah, menanam pohon, dan melindungi satwa adalah langkah sederhana yang dapat dilakukan semua orang.

Sebagai generasi muda, kita adalah calon pemimpin dunia. Kita memiliki kekuatan untuk menciptakan perubahan positif dan menjaga bumi untuk generasi berikutnya.

# Breaking Free from Smoking: Choosing Health Over Harm

Bebas dari Rokok: Memilih Kesehatan daripada Bahaya

English Speech

**Good morning, honorable judges, respected teachers, and my dear friends.**

First of all, let us express our gratitude to God Almighty for giving us health, strength, and the opportunity to gather here today.

It is a great honor for me to stand before you and deliver a speech entitled:
**"Breaking Free from Smoking: Choosing Health Over Harm."**

Ladies and gentlemen,

Health is one of the greatest treasures in our life. Without good health, it is difficult to enjoy our dreams, achieve our goals, and live our lives happily.

However, one of the biggest threats to human health is smoking. Smoking is not only harmful to smokers themselves, but also dangerous for the people around them.

Cigarettes contain harmful substances that can damage our lungs, weaken our bodies, and increase the risk of serious diseases.

Many people start smoking because of curiosity, social pressure, or the desire to look cool. However, behind this temporary feeling, there are many long-term dangers.

Ladies and gentlemen,

Choosing not to smoke is a decision to protect ourselves and the people we love. A healthy life begins with the choices we make every day.

Breaking free from smoking is not always easy, but it is possible. It requires courage, determination, and a strong commitment to change.

Instead of smoking, we can choose healthier habits such as exercising, eating nutritious food, and spending time with positive activities.

Dear friends,

Young people are the future of this world. We must protect our health because our dreams need a strong body and a clear mind.

Do not let cigarettes control your future. Choose health, choose life, and choose a better tomorrow.

Remember, the best time to stop smoking is today.

**Thank you very much for your attention.**

Selamat pagi para juri yang terhormat, guru-guru yang saya hormati, dan teman-teman yang saya cintai.

**"Say No to Drugs: Building a Strong and Healthy Future."**

Ladies and gentlemen,

Life is a precious gift. Every person has dreams, goals, and hopes for the future. To achieve those dreams, we need a healthy body, a clear mind, and positive choices.

However, one of the biggest threats to our future is drug abuse. Drugs can destroy our health, damage our relationships, and prevent us from reaching our goals.

Ladies and gentlemen,

Saying no to drugs is not a sign of weakness. It is a sign of courage and responsibility. A strong person is someone who can make the right choices, even when facing pressure.

We must understand that our future is more valuable than temporary pleasure. Every decision we make today will influence the life we live tomorrow.

Instead of choosing drugs, we should choose positive activities such as learning new skills, exercising, building friendships, and pursuing our dreams.

Dear friends,

Young people are the hope of the nation. We have the power to create a better future, but we must protect ourselves from things that can destroy our potential.

Let us promise ourselves today to stay away from drugs, support each other, and build a strong and healthy future.

Remember, a healthy choice today creates a brighter tomorrow.

**Thank you very much for your attention.**

speeches.title: The Greatest Respect: Honoring the Love and Sacrifice of Parents
speeches.subtitle: Penghormatan Terbesar: Menghargai Cinta dan Pengorbanan Orang Tua
speeches.markdown:
SPEECH LESSON

# The Greatest Respect: Honoring the Love and Sacrifice of Parents

Rasa Hormat Terbesar: Menghargai Cinta dan Pengorbanan Orang Tua

English Speech

**Good morning, honorable judges, respected teachers, and my dear friends.**

First of all, let us express our gratitude to God Almighty for giving us health, happiness, and the opportunity to gather here today.

It is a great honor for me to stand before you and deliver a speech entitled:
**"The Greatest Respect: Honoring the Love and Sacrifice of Parents."**

Ladies and gentlemen,

Parents are the first people who teach us about love, kindness, and life. From the moment we are born, they protect us, guide us, and do everything they can to make us happy.

Behind every success we achieve, there are often countless sacrifices made by our parents. They work hard, face difficulties, and sometimes forget their own needs just to provide the best for their children.

The love of parents is a priceless gift. It cannot be measured by money, because their care, patience, and support are more valuable than anything in this world.

Ladies and gentlemen,

Respecting our parents is not only about saying kind words. It is shown through our actions, such as listening to their advice, helping them, making them proud, and showing gratitude every day.

Sometimes, we are too busy with our own lives that we forget how much our parents have done for us. We should remember that their time, energy, and love are precious gifts.

Dear friends,

We may not always be able to repay all the sacrifices our parents have made. However, we can always give them our respect, love, and appreciation.

A simple smile, a kind word, and a good attitude can bring great happiness to them.

Let us promise ourselves today to become better children, to honor our parents, and to appreciate their endless love.

Remember, behind every great child, there are parents who have given their greatest love and sacrifice.

**Thank you very much for your attention.**

Arti Bahasa Indonesia

Selamat pagi para juri yang terhormat, guru-guru yang saya hormati, dan teman-teman yang saya cintai.

Pertama-tama, marilah kita mengucapkan rasa syukur kepada Tuhan Yang Maha Esa karena telah memberikan kesehatan, kebahagiaan, dan kesempatan untuk berkumpul hari ini.

Merupakan kehormatan besar bagi saya untuk berdiri di depan kalian dan menyampaikan pidato dengan judul:
**"Rasa Hormat Terbesar: Menghargai Cinta dan Pengorbanan Orang Tua."**

Orang tua adalah orang pertama yang mengajarkan kita tentang cinta, kebaikan, dan kehidupan.

Sejak kita lahir, mereka melindungi, membimbing, dan melakukan segala yang mereka bisa untuk membuat kita bahagia.

Di balik setiap kesuksesan yang kita raih, terdapat banyak pengorbanan yang telah dilakukan oleh orang tua kita.

Mereka bekerja keras, menghadapi kesulitan, dan terkadang melupakan kebutuhan mereka sendiri demi memberikan yang terbaik untuk anak-anaknya.

Menghormati orang tua bukan hanya dengan mengucapkan kata-kata baik. Kita menunjukkannya melalui tindakan, seperti mendengarkan nasihat mereka, membantu mereka, membuat mereka bangga, dan menunjukkan rasa terima kasih setiap hari.

Kita mungkin tidak selalu mampu membalas semua pengorbanan orang tua. Namun, kita selalu dapat memberikan rasa hormat, cinta, dan penghargaan kepada mereka.

Ingatlah, di balik setiap anak hebat, ada orang tua yang telah memberikan cinta dan pengorbanan terbesar.

Behind every great child, there are parents who sacrifice everything.

Di balik setiap anak hebat, ada orang tua yang berkorban segalanya.

Inspirational Quote

"A parent's love is the foundation that helps us grow and reach our dreams."

*
Cinta orang tua adalah fondasi yang membantu kita tumbuh dan meraih impian.
*

speeches.title: Teachers: The Heroes Who Shape Our Future
speeches.subtitle: Guru: Pahlawan yang Membentuk Masa Depan Kita

SPEECH LESSON

# Teachers: The Heroes Who Shape Our Future

Guru: Pahlawan yang Membentuk Masa Depan Kita

English Speech

**Good morning, honorable judges, respected teachers, and my dear friends.**

First of all, let us express our gratitude to God Almighty for giving us health, knowledge, and the opportunity to gather here today.

It is a great honor for me to stand before you and deliver a speech entitled:
**"Teachers: The Heroes Who Shape Our Future."**

Ladies and gentlemen,

When we talk about heroes, we often imagine people with great power or extraordinary abilities. However, there are heroes who do not wear special clothes or receive awards. They are our teachers.

Teachers are the people who guide us, educate us, and help us discover our potential. They do not only teach lessons from books, but also teach us important values such as discipline, honesty, responsibility, and kindness.

Every successful person in the world has been influenced by a teacher. Behind every doctor, engineer, leader, and great person, there is a teacher who helped them take their first steps.

Ladies and gentlemen,

Being a teacher is not an easy job. Teachers spend their time, energy, and patience to help students learn and grow. They continue teaching even when they face challenges.

Their greatest reward is not only a good salary or recognition, but seeing their students succeed and achieve their dreams.

Dear friends,

As students, we should respect and appreciate our teachers. We can show our gratitude by studying seriously, listening to their advice, and becoming responsible individuals.

A simple thank you may seem small, but it can mean a lot to a teacher.

Let us remember that teachers are the builders of tomorrow. They plant the seeds of knowledge that will grow into a better future.

Thank you to all teachers who dedicate their lives to educating the next generation.

Sebagai siswa, kita harus menghormati dan menghargai guru. Kita dapat menunjukkan rasa terima kasih dengan belajar sungguh-sungguh, mendengarkan nasihat mereka, dan menjadi pribadi yang bertanggung jawab.

speeches.title: The Future is Ours: Empowering Youth to Lead the World
speeches.subtitle: Masa Depan adalah Milik Kita: Memberdayakan Generasi Muda untuk Memimpin Dunia
speeches.markdown:
SPEECH LESSON

# The Future is Ours: Empowering Youth to Lead the World

Masa Depan Adalah Milik Kita: Memberdayakan Generasi Muda untuk Memimpin Dunia

English Speech

**Good morning, honorable judges, respected teachers, and my dear friends.**

First of all, let us express our gratitude to God Almighty for giving us health, strength, and the opportunity to gather here today.

It is a great honor for me to stand before you and deliver a speech entitled:
**"The Future is Ours: Empowering Youth to Lead the World."**

Ladies and gentlemen,

The world is constantly changing. Every day, we face new challenges such as climate change, technological development, social problems, and global competition.

To overcome these challenges, we need young people who are brave, creative, responsible, and ready to make a difference.

Young people are not only the leaders of tomorrow. We are also the creators of today. Our ideas, actions, and decisions can influence the future of our communities and the world.

Ladies and gentlemen,

Empowering youth means giving young people opportunities to learn, express their ideas, and develop their abilities. When young people are supported, they can create amazing solutions for the problems around them.

Many great changes in history started with young people who dared to dream and take action. Age is not a barrier to making a positive impact.

Dear friends,

Being a future leader does not only mean having power or a high position. A true leader is someone who cares, listens, works hard, and inspires others.

We can start leading from simple things: helping others, protecting the environment, using technology wisely, and continuing to learn.

The future is not something we simply wait for. The future is something we create through our choices and actions today.

Let us believe in ourselves, use our talents, and become the generation that brings positive change to the world.

Remember, the world does not only need young dreamers, but also young people who are ready to act.

**Thank you very much for your attention.**

Arti Bahasa Indonesia

Selamat pagi para juri yang terhormat, guru-guru yang saya hormati, dan teman-teman yang saya cintai.

Memberdayakan generasi muda berarti memberikan kesempatan untuk belajar, menyampaikan ide, dan mengembangkan kemampuan.

Banyak perubahan besar dalam sejarah dimulai dari anak muda yang berani bermimpi dan mengambil tindakan.

Menjadi pemimpin masa depan bukan hanya tentang memiliki kekuasaan atau jabatan tinggi. Pemimpin sejati adalah seseorang yang peduli, mau mendengarkan, bekerja keras, dan menginspirasi orang lain.

Masa depan bukan sesuatu yang hanya kita tunggu. Masa depan adalah sesuatu yang kita ciptakan melalui pilihan dan tindakan kita hari ini.

speeches.title: Beyond Technology: Preserving Humanity in the Digital Revolution
speeches.subtitle: Melampaui Teknologi: Menjaga Kemanusiaan di Era Revolusi Digital
speeches.markdown:
SPEECH LESSON

# Beyond Technology: Preserving Humanity in the Digital Revolution

Melampaui Teknologi: Menjaga Kemanusiaan dalam Revolusi Digital

English Speech

**Good morning, honorable judges, respected teachers, and my dear friends.**

First of all, let us express our gratitude to God Almighty for giving us health, knowledge, and the opportunity to gather here today.

It is a great honor for me to stand before you and deliver a speech entitled:
**"Beyond Technology: Preserving Humanity in the Digital Revolution."**

Ladies and gentlemen,

We are living in an extraordinary era. Technology has changed the way we communicate, learn, work, and experience the world. With just one click, we can access information, connect with people across the globe, and discover new opportunities.

Technology has brought many benefits to human life. However, as technology continues to grow, we must remember one important thing: technology should serve humanity, not replace it.

Ladies and gentlemen,

The digital revolution has also created new challenges. People are spending more time with screens and less time connecting directly with others. Sometimes, we become so focused on the virtual world that we forget the importance of real human relationships.

No machine can truly replace kindness, empathy, creativity, and compassion. These are qualities that make us human.

Technology can help us achieve great things, but it is our values that determine how we use it.

Dear friends,

As the younger generation, we must become wise digital citizens. We should use technology responsibly, spread positive information, respect others online, and protect our privacy.

The future is not only about having smarter machines. It is about creating a world where technology and humanity can grow together.

Let us embrace innovation while protecting the values that make us truly human.

Remember, technology may change the world, but humanity gives it meaning.

**Thank you very much for your attention.**

Arti Bahasa Indonesia

Selamat pagi para juri yang terhormat, guru-guru yang saya hormati, dan teman-teman yang saya cintai.

Pertama-tama, marilah kita mengucapkan rasa syukur kepada Tuhan Yang Maha Esa karena telah memberikan kesehatan, ilmu, dan kesempatan untuk berkumpul hari ini.

Merupakan kehormatan besar bagi saya untuk berdiri di depan kalian dan menyampaikan pidato dengan judul:
**"Melampaui Teknologi: Menjaga Kemanusiaan dalam Revolusi Digital."**

Kita hidup di era yang luar biasa. Teknologi telah mengubah cara kita berkomunikasi, belajar, bekerja, dan merasakan dunia.

Dengan satu klik, kita dapat mengakses informasi, terhubung dengan orang-orang di seluruh dunia, dan menemukan berbagai peluang baru.

Teknologi telah memberikan banyak manfaat bagi kehidupan manusia. Namun, seiring berkembangnya teknologi, kita harus mengingat satu hal penting: teknologi harus melayani manusia, bukan menggantikan manusia.

Revolusi digital juga menciptakan tantangan baru. Banyak orang menghabiskan lebih banyak waktu dengan layar dan lebih sedikit berinteraksi secara langsung dengan orang lain.

Tidak ada mesin yang benar-benar dapat menggantikan kebaikan, empati, kreativitas, dan kepedulian. Hal-hal tersebut adalah nilai yang membuat kita menjadi manusia.

Sebagai generasi muda, kita harus menjadi pengguna teknologi yang bijak. Kita harus menggunakan teknologi dengan bertanggung jawab, menyebarkan informasi positif, menghormati orang lain di dunia digital, dan menjaga privasi.

Masa depan bukan hanya tentang memiliki mesin yang lebih pintar. Masa depan adalah tentang menciptakan dunia di mana teknologi dan kemanusiaan dapat berkembang bersama.

Ingatlah, teknologi mungkin dapat mengubah dunia, tetapi kemanusiaan memberikan makna di dalamnya.

QUOTE

Technology may change the world, but humanity gives it meaning.

Teknologi mungkin mengubah dunia, tetapi kemanusiaan memberikan makna.

Inspirational Quote

"The greatest innovation is not creating smarter machines, but becoming wiser humans."

*
Inovasi terbesar bukan hanya menciptakan mesin yang lebih pintar, tetapi menjadi manusia yang lebih bijaksana.
*

speeches.title: The Last Generation or The First Solution: Our Fight Against Climate Change
speeches.subtitle: Generasi Terakhir atau Solusi Pertama: Perjuangan Melawan Perubahan Iklim
speeches.markdown:
SPEECH LESSON

# The Last Generation or The First Solution: Our Fight Against Climate Change

Generasi Terakhir atau Solusi Pertama: Perjuangan Kita Melawan Perubahan Iklim

English Speech

**Good morning, honorable judges, respected teachers, and my dear friends.**

First of all, let us express our gratitude to God Almighty for giving us health, strength, and the opportunity to gather here today.

It is a great honor for me to stand before you and deliver a speech entitled:
**"The Last Generation or The First Solution: Our Fight Against Climate Change."**

Ladies and gentlemen,

Our planet is sending us a message. Rising temperatures, extreme weather, melting ice, and natural disasters are signs that our Earth is facing a serious challenge called climate change.

Climate change is not just an environmental issue. It is a challenge that affects our health, economy, food supply, and the future of every living creature on this planet.

Today, we stand at an important moment in history. We can either become the last generation that ignores this problem, or become the first generation that creates real solutions.

Ladies and gentlemen,

Many people think that fighting climate change is only the responsibility of governments and large organizations. However, every individual has the power to make a difference.

Simple actions such as reducing waste, saving energy, planting trees, using public transportation, and protecting nature can create meaningful changes.

The choices we make today will determine the world we live in tomorrow.

Dear friends,

Young people have an important role in protecting our planet. We are not too young to create change. Our voices, ideas, and actions can inspire millions of people.

We must stop asking, "Who will solve this problem?" and start asking, "What can I do to become part of the solution?"

The Earth does not need perfect people. It needs millions of people who are willing to make better choices.

Let us become the generation that protects nature, restores hope, and builds a sustainable future.

Remember, the future of our planet is not decided tomorrow. It is created by what we do today.

**Thank you very much for your attention.**

Arti Bahasa Indonesia

Selamat pagi para juri yang terhormat, guru-guru yang saya hormati, dan teman-teman yang saya cintai.

Pertama-tama, marilah kita mengucapkan rasa syukur kepada Tuhan Yang Maha Esa karena telah memberikan kesehatan, kekuatan, dan kesempatan untuk berkumpul hari ini.

Merupakan kehormatan besar bagi saya untuk berdiri di depan kalian dan menyampaikan pidato dengan judul:
**"Generasi Terakhir atau Solusi Pertama: Perjuangan Kita Melawan Perubahan Iklim."**

Planet kita sedang memberikan sebuah pesan. Meningkatnya suhu bumi, cuaca ekstrem, mencairnya es, dan bencana alam menjadi tanda bahwa bumi menghadapi tantangan serius yang disebut perubahan iklim.

Perubahan iklim bukan hanya masalah lingkungan. Ini adalah tantangan yang memengaruhi kesehatan, ekonomi, sumber makanan, dan masa depan seluruh makhluk hidup di planet ini.

Hari ini, kita berada pada momen penting dalam sejarah. Kita dapat menjadi generasi terakhir yang mengabaikan masalah ini, atau menjadi generasi pertama yang menciptakan solusi nyata.

Banyak orang berpikir bahwa melawan perubahan iklim hanya tanggung jawab pemerintah dan organisasi besar. Namun, setiap orang memiliki kekuatan untuk membuat perubahan.

Tindakan sederhana seperti mengurangi sampah, menghemat energi, menanam pohon, menggunakan transportasi umum, dan menjaga alam dapat menciptakan perubahan besar.

Generasi muda memiliki peran penting dalam menjaga planet ini. Kita tidak terlalu muda untuk menciptakan perubahan.

Jangan lagi bertanya, "Siapa yang akan menyelesaikan masalah ini?" tetapi tanyakan, "Apa yang bisa saya lakukan untuk menjadi bagian dari solusi?"

Mari menjadi generasi yang melindungi alam, mengembalikan harapan, dan membangun masa depan yang berkelanjutan.

Ingatlah, masa depan bumi tidak ditentukan besok. Masa depan bumi diciptakan melalui apa yang kita lakukan hari ini.

⭐ Highlight Learning

VOCAB

Climate Change

Perubahan iklim

VOCAB

Sustainable

Berkelanjutan

VOCAB

Solution

Solusi / penyelesaian masalah

EXPRESSION

Be part of the solution

Menjadi bagian dari solusi

SPEECH

Our planet is sending us a message.

Planet kita sedang mengirimkan sebuah pesan kepada kita.

QUOTE

The Earth does not need perfect people. It needs people who care.

Bumi tidak membutuhkan manusia yang sempurna. Bumi membutuhkan manusia yang peduli.

Inspirational Quote

"We do not inherit the Earth from our ancestors; we borrow it from our children."

*
Kita tidak mewarisi bumi dari leluhur kita; kita meminjamnya dari anak-anak kita.
*

speeches.title: Education Without Limits: Creating a Better Future for Everyone
speeches.subtitle: Pendidikan Tanpa Batas: Menciptakan Masa Depan Lebih Baik untuk Semua
speeches.markdown:
SPEECH LESSON

# Education Without Limits: Creating a Better Future for Everyone

Pendidikan Tanpa Batas: Menciptakan Masa Depan yang Lebih Baik untuk Semua

English Speech

**Good morning, honorable judges, respected teachers, and my dear friends.**

First of all, let us express our gratitude to God Almighty for giving us health, knowledge, and the opportunity to gather here today.

It is a great honor for me to stand before you and deliver a speech entitled:
**"Education Without Limits: Creating a Better Future for Everyone."**

Ladies and gentlemen,

Education is one of the most powerful tools in human life. It gives us knowledge, develops our skills, and helps us understand the world around us.

Education is not only about learning facts from books. It is about building character, developing creativity, and preparing ourselves to face the challenges of the future.

However, many people around the world still do not have equal access to education. Some children cannot go to school because of poverty, distance, or difficult conditions.

This reminds us that education should not have limits. Every child deserves the opportunity to learn, dream, and create a better future.

Ladies and gentlemen,

In today's digital era, education has become more accessible than ever. Technology allows us to learn from anywhere, discover new information, and connect with knowledge around the world.

But technology alone is not enough. We also need determination, curiosity, and the willingness to continue learning.

Dear friends,

Education can change lives. A person who receives education can create opportunities not only for themselves but also for their families and communities.

Great nations are built by educated people who have knowledge, skills, and strong values.

As students and young people, we must appreciate every learning opportunity we have. We should never stop asking questions, exploring ideas, and improving ourselves.

Let us believe that education has no boundaries. Together, we can create a world where everyone has the chance to learn and succeed.

Remember, education is not just the key to success. It is the foundation for a better future.

**Thank you very much for your attention.**

Arti Bahasa Indonesia

Selamat pagi para juri yang terhormat, guru-guru yang saya hormati, dan teman-teman yang saya cintai.

Pertama-tama, marilah kita mengucapkan rasa syukur kepada Tuhan Yang Maha Esa karena telah memberikan kesehatan, ilmu, dan kesempatan untuk berkumpul hari ini.

Merupakan kehormatan besar bagi saya untuk berdiri di depan kalian dan menyampaikan pidato dengan judul:
**"Pendidikan Tanpa Batas: Menciptakan Masa Depan yang Lebih Baik untuk Semua."**

Pendidikan adalah salah satu alat paling kuat dalam kehidupan manusia. Pendidikan memberikan pengetahuan, mengembangkan kemampuan, dan membantu kita memahami dunia di sekitar kita.

Pendidikan bukan hanya tentang mempelajari fakta dari buku. Pendidikan juga tentang membangun karakter, mengembangkan kreativitas, dan mempersiapkan diri menghadapi tantangan masa depan.

Namun, masih banyak orang di dunia yang belum mendapatkan akses pendidikan yang sama. Beberapa anak tidak dapat bersekolah karena kemiskinan, jarak, atau kondisi yang sulit.

Hal ini mengingatkan kita bahwa pendidikan seharusnya tidak memiliki batas. Setiap anak berhak mendapatkan kesempatan untuk belajar, bermimpi, dan menciptakan masa depan yang lebih baik.

Di era digital saat ini, pendidikan menjadi lebih mudah diakses. Teknologi memungkinkan kita belajar dari mana saja dan menemukan informasi baru.

Namun teknologi saja tidak cukup. Kita juga membutuhkan tekad, rasa ingin tahu, dan kemauan untuk terus belajar.

Pendidikan dapat mengubah kehidupan. Seseorang yang mendapatkan pendidikan dapat menciptakan peluang bukan hanya untuk dirinya sendiri, tetapi juga untuk keluarga dan masyarakat.

# Young Minds, Great Changes: The Power of Youth Leadership

It is a great honor for me to stand before you and deliver a speech entitled:
**"Young Minds, Great Changes: The Power of Youth Leadership."**

Ladies and gentlemen,

When we look at the world today, we can see many changes happening around us. Technology is developing rapidly, social problems are increasing, and our planet faces many challenges.

In the middle of these changes, one group has the power to create a better future: young people.

Young minds have fresh ideas, unlimited creativity, and the courage to imagine something better. Although we are still young, our voices and actions can create meaningful changes in society.

Leadership is not only about having a position or giving orders. True leadership is about responsibility, courage, kindness, and the ability to inspire others.

A young leader does not wait for change to happen. A young leader takes action, finds solutions, and encourages others to do the same.

History has shown us that many great movements began with young people who believed in their dreams. They proved that age is not a limitation when we have passion and determination.

As the younger generation, we must prepare ourselves to become future leaders. We can start by developing knowledge, improving our skills, respecting others, and being brave enough to share our ideas.

Small actions can create big impacts. Helping our community, protecting the environment, and spreading kindness are examples of youth leadership.

The world does not need young people who only dream. The world needs young people who are willing to take action.

speeches.title: Artificial Intelligence: Will Humans Control Technology or Be Controlled by It?

speeches.markdown:
SPEECH LESSON

# Artificial Intelligence: Will Humans Control Technology or Be Controlled by It?

Kecerdasan Buatan: Apakah Manusia Akan Mengendalikan Teknologi atau Dikendalikan Olehnya?

English Speech

**Good morning, honorable judges, respected teachers, and my dear friends.**

First of all, let us express our gratitude to God Almighty for giving us health, knowledge, and the opportunity to gather here today.

It is a great honor for me to stand before you and deliver a speech entitled:
**"Artificial Intelligence: Will Humans Control Technology or Be Controlled by It?"**

Ladies and gentlemen,

We are living in an era where technology is developing faster than ever before. One of the greatest inventions of our time is Artificial Intelligence, or commonly known as AI.

Artificial Intelligence has changed the way we live, work, and learn. It can help doctors diagnose diseases, assist students in learning, improve businesses, and solve complex problems.

However, as AI becomes more powerful, an important question appears:
**Will humans control technology, or will technology control humans?**

Ladies and gentlemen,

Technology itself is not good or bad. The impact of technology depends on how humans use it. AI can become a powerful tool to improve our lives, but it can also create problems if we use it without responsibility.

We must remember that machines can process information, but they do not have emotions, morality, or human values. These qualities belong to us.

The greatest challenge in the age of AI is not creating smarter machines, but becoming wiser humans.

Dear friends,

As the younger generation, we must learn how to use technology wisely. We should develop digital skills, think critically, protect our privacy, and use AI for positive purposes.

We should not fear technology, but we should understand it and guide its development in the right direction.

The future will not be decided by technology alone. It will be decided by the choices and responsibilities of humanity.

Let us make sure that AI becomes a partner that helps humans grow, not a force that controls our lives.

Remember, technology may be powerful, but human wisdom must always lead the way.

**Thank you very much for your attention.**

Arti Bahasa Indonesia

Selamat pagi para juri yang terhormat, guru-guru yang saya hormati, dan teman-teman yang saya cintai.

Pertama-tama, marilah kita mengucapkan rasa syukur kepada Tuhan Yang Maha Esa karena telah memberikan kesehatan, ilmu, dan kesempatan untuk berkumpul hari ini.

Merupakan kehormatan besar bagi saya untuk berdiri di depan kalian dan menyampaikan pidato dengan judul:
**"Kecerdasan Buatan: Apakah Manusia Akan Mengendalikan Teknologi atau Dikendalikan Olehnya?"**

Kita hidup di era di mana teknologi berkembang lebih cepat dari sebelumnya. Salah satu penemuan terbesar saat ini adalah Kecerdasan Buatan atau Artificial Intelligence (AI).

AI telah mengubah cara kita hidup, bekerja, dan belajar. AI dapat membantu dokter mendiagnosis penyakit, membantu siswa belajar, meningkatkan bisnis, dan menyelesaikan masalah yang kompleks.

Namun, ketika AI menjadi semakin kuat, muncul sebuah pertanyaan penting:
**Apakah manusia akan mengendalikan teknologi atau justru dikendalikan oleh teknologi?**

Teknologi itu sendiri tidak baik atau buruk. Dampak teknologi bergantung pada bagaimana manusia menggunakannya.

AI dapat menjadi alat yang luar biasa untuk meningkatkan kehidupan manusia, tetapi juga dapat menimbulkan masalah jika digunakan tanpa tanggung jawab.

Kita harus ingat bahwa mesin dapat memproses informasi, tetapi mesin tidak memiliki emosi, moral, dan nilai kemanusiaan. Hal-hal tersebut adalah milik manusia.

Tantangan terbesar di era AI bukan hanya menciptakan mesin yang lebih pintar, tetapi menjadi manusia yang lebih bijaksana.

Sebagai generasi muda, kita harus belajar menggunakan teknologi dengan bijak. Kita harus mengembangkan kemampuan digital, berpikir kritis, menjaga privasi, dan menggunakan AI untuk tujuan positif.

Kita tidak boleh takut terhadap teknologi, tetapi kita harus memahami dan mengarahkan perkembangannya ke arah yang benar.

Masa depan tidak hanya ditentukan oleh teknologi. Masa depan ditentukan oleh pilihan dan tanggung jawab manusia.

Mari pastikan AI menjadi mitra yang membantu manusia berkembang, bukan kekuatan yang mengendalikan kehidupan kita.

Ingatlah, teknologi mungkin kuat, tetapi kebijaksanaan manusia harus selalu menjadi pemimpin.

⭐ Highlight Learning
